meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase event time using 30 minutes option succeeds
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the test configuration.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer visibility configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the test configuration.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the test configuration.
Open the RFQ stage where its submission-time settings are available.
Reach the RFQ Responses view described by the test before opening Settings.
Select the 30-minute submission-time preset, save it, and verify the event end time advances by 30 minutes.
Assert the expected success toast after the extension is saved.
